title: Get project
name: get_project
description: The sequence (size, frame rate, length), tracks, and every clip with its id, track, times, source, grade, sound and transition.

request.description: The user's video request for the Studio conversation.

direction.description: Action, camera, and audio for this shot.

continuity.description: Shared subjects, setting, lighting, and look.

title: Render video in Magic Studio
name: studio_render_video
description: Available outside an Edit with Magic draft. Submits a timed plan to ComfyUI and appends the result to the open timeline. Pass clip lengths in seconds. For a total runtime, give totalSeconds and durations that add up to it. Returns a run ID immediately.

title: Check a Magic Studio render
description: Reads the progress, result asset IDs, or error for a video run in the open project. Poll the same run ID instead of resubmitting.
name: studio_video_status

run_id.description: The run ID returned by studio_render_video.

title: Generate a shot for Magic

action.description: One main visible action, including camera motion and audio if relevant.

continue_from_clip_id.description: The preceding video clip ID from get_project or add_clip. Its last visible frame becomes the starting reference.

end_pose.description: Where the subjects and camera should be at the end.

start_pose.description: Positions, poses, direction of movement and framing when the shot starts.

continuity.description: Shared look, subject identities, wardrobe, setting and lighting.

name: render_video_shot
description: Edit with Magic only. Queue one candidate shot on the configured ComfyUI worker. Returns a shot_id for review_video_shot. When continuing the edit, specify the previous placed video clip, from this draft or a past edit, to use its last visible frame after trimming.

Edit with Magic only. Waits for the candidate and shows chronological rendered frames from beginning through end, with the input references when present. If it's still rendering, call again with the same ID. Compare the planned action, direction and continuity. Request additional times when a moment is unclear.
title: Inspect generated footage
name: review_video_shot

times.description: Optional additional seconds in the shot to inspect.

title: Accept or reject reviewed footage
name: decide_video_shot
description: Edit with Magic only. Call after inspecting the rendered frames. Accept if the visible action works and the edit can use it, then pass the returned asset_id and intended source range to add_clip. Reject a candidate that drifts, reverses unexpectedly or misses its action, and regenerate only that shot.

accept.description: True to make the reviewed shot available for add_clip.

notes.description: Describe the action and continuity you actually saw, or the specific reason to reject it.

shot_id.description: A shot whose frames you reviewed.

title: List media
name: list_media
description: Everything in the library: id, name, kind (video, audio, image), the folder it's in, length, size, frame rate, what it shows, whether people talk in it, and notes saved from looking at it before.
Adds files to the library. A folder brings in everything in it (and in folders inside it) and stays linked: files added to it later come in too, and list_media gives each item's folder.
title: Import media

paths.description: Absolute paths of files or folders.

name: import_media

title: Download media
description: Downloads one music or sound file you found online and adds it to the library, ready for add_clip. Give the direct link to the audio file (an .mp3, .m4a or .wav), not a web page. Only for music that's free to use; say where you found it and what its licence allows, which is noted beside the file.

licence.description: What the licence says, for example "Pixabay Content License: free to use, no attribution required".

name.description: What to call it, like the track and artist.

source_page.description: The page you found it on.

url.description: https link to the audio file itself.

name: download_media
analyze_media

moment_length.description: Length of moments to look for, in seconds (default 2).

title: Analyze media
description: For a video or photo: its best moments, scored for focus, exposure, colour, faces and steadiness. For music: tempo, beats and where bars start. Done on this Mac; cached.

What's said in a video or sound file, heard on this Mac: its sentences and pauses with their times in the file (and each word's time if you ask). Use it for anything with people talking: to cut pauses, retakes and filler, keep sentences whole, find a moment by what's said, or put pictures over the talking. Made in the background after import; cached.
name: get_transcript

words.description: Also every word with its start and end (default false).

title: Get transcript

name: look_at_media

frames.description: How many frames from across a video (default 6, at most 12).

times.description: Or exactly which times in the file to show, in seconds (at most 12).

title: Look at media
description: Shows you a library item: a photo, or frames from across a video in a grid, each marked with its time in the file. Use it to see what's in each shot before choosing.

notes.description: What's in it, with times, like "0-3s girl in a high chair eating noodles; 3-8s close-up, laughing at the camera, best moment 5s; bright kitchen, handheld but steady."

description: Saves what you saw in a library item after looking at it, for later edits: what happens and where (times in the file), the people, the place, the light, how steady, and its best and weakest moments. Two or three short lines. list_media hands it back as "notes", so it needn't be looked at again. Replaces any note it had; kept on this Mac, never in the project.
name: note_media
title: Note what's in media
Get frame
description: A picture of the cut at a time (default: the playhead), 640 pixels on its longer side.
name: get_frame

description: Drags a library item onto the timeline. A video with sound brings its audio, linked.
name: add_clip

start.description: Where on the timeline (default: the end of the track).

source_start.description: Where in the file to start (default 0).

track.description: V1, V2… for video and photos; A1, A2… for audio (default V1 or A1).

duration.description: How long (default: the rest of the file; 5 for a photo).

title: Add clip

description: Adds a text title, typed in.

track.description: A video track (default: one that's free there, above V1).

name: add_title
title: Add title

name: move_clip
description: Moves a clip (and anything linked to it) in time, and optionally to another track of the same kind.
title: Move clip
Trim clip
name: trim_clip
description: Moves a clip's start and/or end edge on the timeline (and its linked clip's). The source moves with the start edge.

name: set_speed
title: Set speed
description: Speeds a clip (and its linked sound) up or slows it down, keeping the same part of the file: 4 plays four times as fast and a quarter as long (a timelapse), 0.5 is slow motion. Clips after it on the track move to stay butted up.

title: Set speed ramp
description: A speed ramp on a clip (and its linked sound): it plays at `around` speed, eases into `speed` for the part of the file from `from` to `to`, then eases back. For a slow-motion moment (speed 0.25, around 1), fast-normal-fast B-roll (speed 1, around 4), or ramping into a cut (`to` left out, `speed` 4: it eases up toward the clip's end). Times are seconds in the file, like source_start. The clip's length changes; clips after it on the track move to stay butted up. remove: true takes a clip's ramp away.

remove.description: Take the clip's ramp away (its speed stays).

from.description: Seconds in the file where it reaches `speed` (default: the clip's start, so no ease in).

ease.description: Seconds of the file each ease takes (default 0.4).

to.description: Seconds in the file where it starts easing back (default: the clip's end, so no ease out).

speed.description: The speed from `from` to `to`, 0.05...100 (1 is normal).

name: set_speed_ramp

highlight.description: Light up each word as it's said (default true).

edit.description: Captions to change, each found by a timeline time inside it (as set_captions or get_project return them): the words it should say, or "" to take it out. The caption keeps its time.

hidden.description: Hide or show the caption track (hidden captions aren't exported).

clip_ids.description: Clips whose speech to caption (or un-caption with remove).

position.description: Where they sit, 0.1 (top) to 0.95 (bottom) of the frame (default 0.78).

name: set_captions
title: Set captions
description: Captions from what's said: a caption track above the video shows the words of each captioned clip in short phrases, timed to the speech, and follows every trim and move of those clips. Give clip_ids to caption those clips' speech (a video's sound is its linked audio clip); with none, every clip of people talking is captioned (sound from video files and voiceover tracks, not music). Also sets the captions' style, and with edit fixes captions: a misheard word, a name spelled right, or a caption taken out. remove: true takes captions off clip_ids, or removes the caption track with none. Returns the captions.
Cuts a clip (and its linked clip) in two with the blade. Returns the new right-hand pieces.
name: split_clip
title: Split clip

ripple.description: Close the gap left behind (default false).

description: Deletes clips and anything linked to them.
title: Delete clips
name: delete_clips

look.description: A look from list_looks, a .cube file path, or "none".

title: Set grade
description: Colour for video, photo and title clips. Leave out what shouldn't change.
name: set_grade
list_looks
title: List looks
description: The built-in looks for set_grade.

title: Set level and fades
description: A clip's sound level, and its fades: a sound clip's fade its sound, a video, photo, title or solid's fade its picture (in from black, out to black).
name: set_audio
set_transition
title: Set transition
description: A transition into a clip from the clip that ends where it starts on the same track.

name: add_track
description: Adds an empty track on top of the others of its kind.
title: Add track

name: set_sequence
title: Set sequence
description: The frame size and frame rate of the cut.

title: Playback
name: playback
description: Play, pause or move the playhead.
Undoes or redoes the last change (each tool call is one change).
name: history
title: Undo or redo

description: Builds a whole cut from the library on its own: best moments, cut to the beat of a song if there is one, titled. Replaces what's on the timeline (one undo brings it back).
name: auto_edit
title: Auto edit
Save project
description: Saves the project to its file. A project that's never been saved has to be saved by the person.
name: save_project
export
description: Exports the cut to a file, in the background (export_status says how it's going, or set wait). Saved in the folder the person last exported to (else beside the project, else Movies); never over an existing file. Not available while making a Magic edit.
title: Export

wait.description: Wait until it's done (up to about 4 minutes) instead of returning straight away.

height.description: Output height in pixels (for vertical, square and portrait: the short side), e.g. 720, 1080, 2160. Default: the sequence's.

reframe_x.description: For a crop: which part to keep, 0 (left) to 1 (right). Default 0.5.

format.description: An MP4, or a WAV of the sound (default video).

shape.description: original is the sequence's own shape; vertical 9:16, square 1:1 and portrait 4:5 crop it.

loudness.description: Target loudness in LUFS: -14 for YouTube and social, -16 for podcasts, -23 for broadcast. Leave out to keep the levels.

name.description: File name, without extension (default: the project's).

description: Exports started from Editroom (by anyone): their files and whether they're waiting, running, done or failed.
title: Export status
name: export_status

title: Search media
description: Finds library items by what they show (people, places, things: "beach", "dog", "car at night") and/or what's said in them, with the times in each file. Much quicker than looking at or transcribing each one. Seen and heard on this Mac in the background after import, so a new file may not be searchable yet.

shows.description: Words for what's in the shot; every word has to match.

name: search_media

description: Adds a marker on the timeline, or changes one (give marker_id, from get_project). Use markers when asked to mark moments (beats, highlights, places to cut).
title: Set marker

time.description: Timeline seconds (needed for a new marker).

name: set_marker
delete_markers
description: Removes markers.
title: Delete markers

name: set_in_out
title: Set in and out
description: The in/out range: what Loop plays and what export can be limited to (range_only).

title: Position, scale and zoom

zoom.description: Animate: in (full frame to this framing), in_out (in, hold, back out at the end), out (from this framing back to the full frame), or off (stay at this framing).

zoom_seconds.description: How long each move takes (default a quarter of the clip, 0.5 to 2 seconds).

zoom_start.description: Seconds into the clip when the move starts: for in and in_out, when it starts moving in (default 0); for out, when it starts moving out (default so it ends with the clip).

reset.description: Back to fitted and centred, with no zoom.

zoom_smooth.description: Eased in and out (the default), or false for an even pace.

focus_x.description: Instead of x: the point to frame, across the picture (0 left edge, 0.5 centre, 1 right edge). Scaled up, the picture is placed so that point is centred, as near as its edges allow.

scale.description: 1 fits the frame; 2 is twice as big (0.05...10). With zoom, how far in it goes (default 2).

x.description: Offset of its centre across, as a fraction of the frame's width (0 is centred, 0.5 is the right edge).

y.description: Offset down, as a fraction of the frame's height (0 is centred, positive is lower).

focus_y.description: Instead of y: the point to frame, down the picture (0 top, 0.5 centre, 1 bottom).

name: set_transform
description: Moves and scales a video, photo or solid in the frame, for reframing (keeping a subject in a vertical crop, a picture-in-picture). With zoom, it animates over the clip between the full frame and this scale and framing: pushing in on a moment, or following the action in a screen recording. A title's place is set with set_title_style.

title: Title style
description: A title's words and look. Leave out what shouldn't change.

font.description: A font family installed on this Mac, or "System".

name: set_title_style

description: Holds one frame of a video clip: the clip is cut there, the held frame goes in, and what follows on its tracks moves along to make room.
name: freeze_frame

at.description: Timeline time inside the clip (default: its middle).

title: Freeze frame

name: reverse_clip
title: Reverse
description: Plays a clip (and its linked sound) backwards; again plays it forwards.

name: detach_audio
description: Unlinks a video from its sound, so each can be moved, trimmed or deleted on its own.
title: Detach audio

clip_id.description: The video's or its sound's id.

title: Duplicate clip
name: duplicate_clip
description: Copies a clip (and anything linked to it) to another time.

start.description: Where the copy starts (default: straight after the clip).

description: A track's switches and level.
title: Set track
name: set_track

description: Adds a solid colour (a background, a flash, a colour card).
title: Add solid
name: add_solid

track.description: A video track (default: one that's free there).

name: set_solid_color
description: Changes a solid's colour.
title: Solid colour
